Abhishek,

I am assuming you are talking about the application on shinyapps.io, right?
A better forum for shinyapps.io questions and issues is this one:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users

- Can you send the URL to your application?
- In cases that screen goes grey in a couple of minutes, do you see any errors in the browser JavaConsole?
- Can you please run shinyapps::showLogs() command for your application in case any errors have been logged.

And it is always helpful to know the output of sessionInfo() command.


Best,
Fereshteh
